heading: Use the past tense

phrases.en: I got married in the spring.
We called to say that we love you.
The soldier volunteered to run to the bridge.

phrases.he: הוא עוד לא התאושש מהמסיבה אתמול בערב.
phrases.en: He has not recovered yet from the party last night.

sentences.en: The rain stopped.
You've received a gift!
I continued writing.
Did you shave today?
I got married in spring.
He bathed in oil.
She hid in the closet.
She called the police.
I recovered and I am ready.
I ignored his offer.
I have one percent more.
He got undressed at the doctor's.
It rained last night.
All the watermelons exploded.
We haven't received anything from you.
He didn't receive the letter.
Why did you stop speaking with him?
Which animals do you love?
The bride fainted at her wedding.
The judge said that they were not abusive.
The tourists complained about the situation.

sentences.he: הוא התנצל על מה שהוא עשה?
sentences.en: Did he apologize for what he did?
The soldier recovered and continued running.
The soldier volunteered to run to the bridge.
She apologized for dinner.
I did not get drunk, I was only happy.
Our children do not like tomatoes.
His mom prayed that he would agree.
The children love the zoo.

sentences.he: למה הם לא אוהבים לגור כאן?
sentences.en: Why don't they like to live here?
The student ignored the teacher completely.
I fainted when she told me to go.
I hid in the bushes next to the school.

sentences.he: התחננתי אבל זה לא היה מספיק.
sentences.en: I begged but it wasn't enough.

sentences.he: לא היה לו מים, אז הוא התעלף.
sentences.en: He did not have water, so he fainted.

sentences.he: הפסקתי ללכת לשם לפני חצי שנה.
sentences.en: I stopped going there half a year ago.
The captain complained that the airplane is not clean.
They are standing where we are standing.

sentences.he: הוא התחבא ממני אבל מצאתי אותו.
sentences.en: He hid from me but I found him.

sentences.he: הכלב הגדול לא התעלל בחתול הקטן.
sentences.en: The big dog did not abuse the small cat.

sentences.he: הן התאוששו אבל הן עדיין עייפות.
sentences.en: They recovered but they are still tired.
Despite the snow, I prayed at the synagogue.
My car exploded two days ago.
We called to say that we love you.

sentences.he: אנחנו לא אוהבים את הטירה הגדולה.
sentences.en: We do not like the large castle.

sentences.he: הוא המשיך לדבר למרות שאני הפסקתי.
sentences.en: He continued to speak even though I stopped.

sentences.he: הוא ירד למרתף ולא ראינו אותו מאז.
sentences.en: He went down to the basement and we haven't seen him since.

sentences.he: היא הייתה צעירה מדי כשהיא התחתנה.
sentences.en: She was too young when she got married.

sentences.he: התיעצתי איתו לגבי חיית מחמד חדשה.
sentences.en: I consulted with him in regards to a new pet.

sentences.he: שמעתי רעש מוזר אבל התעלמתי מהריח.
sentences.en: I heard a strange noise but I ignored the smell.

sentences.he: הם התחתנו בשבוע שעבר בארצות הברית.
sentences.en: They got married last week in the United States.

sentences.he: ירדתי במדרגות אבל היא לא הייתה שם.
sentences.en: I went down the stairs but she wasn't there.

sentences.he: היא הולכת לחנות לקנות עוד עפרונות.
sentences.en: She is going to the store to buy more pencils.

sentences.he: אני מכבד אותךָ, אבל עוד לא התנצלתָ.
sentences.en: I respect you, but you have not apologized yet.

sentences.he: עכשיו אתה מתפלל? למה לא התפללתָ אתמול?
sentences.en: Now you are praying? Why didn't you pray yesterday?

sentences.he: כמו תמיד, הקוף התלונן שהבננה ירוקה מדי.
sentences.en: As always, the monkey complained that the banana is too green.

sentences.he: התיעצנו עם עורך הדין והוא אמר לנו לברוח.
sentences.en: We consulted with the lawyer and he told us to run away.

sentences.he: כשהייתי מדריך, הם התיעצו איתי כמה פעמים.
sentences.en: When I was a guide, they consulted with me a few times.

sentences.he: הוא לא הולך למסיבה אבל הוא התגלח בכל זאת.
sentences.en: He is not going to the party but he shaved anyway.

sentences.he: מה אתם אוהבים? עוגות שוקולד או עוגות גבינה?
sentences.en: What do you like? Chocolate cakes or cheese cakes?

sentences.he: לפי דעתי הם התנדבו בגלל שהבוס שלהם ביקש מהם.
sentences.en: In my opinion they volunteered because their boss asked them to.

sentences.he: היא התנדבה לעזור וללמד את הילדים שלי היסטוריה.
sentences.en: She volunteered to help and teach my children History.

sentences.he: למרות שהתקשרתי לפני שהגעתי, הם כבר הלכו הביתה.
sentences.en: Even though I called before I arrived, they had already gone home.

sentences.he: בדרך כלל אני מתגלח לפני שבת אבל השבוע לא התגלחתי כי לא היה לי זמן.
sentences.en: Usually I shave before Saturday but this week I did not shave because I did not have time.

hints.יש: I have / do you have / has
hints.בלילה: after midnight / at night / in the night
hints.אתם: do you want / you / you are
hints.מה: everything / nothing can be done / there is nothing to do
hints.הילדים: the boys / the children / the kids
hints.החיות: at the zoo / in the zoo / the animals
hints.ללכת: go / to go, walk / to walk, go
hints.הגדול: biggest / the big (masculine singular) / the greatest
hints.בבית: at home / home / in the house
hints.לומר: to say / to tell / to say, tell
hints.שאני: after I / that I / that I am
hints.לקנות: to buy / buy, purchase / to buy, purchase
hints.אני: I / I am / I am a girl
hints.אותךָ: you / thee, you (masculine singular) / thee, you (feminine singular)
hints.לברוח: escape, run away / to run away, escape
hints.לפי: in my opinion / according to / by
hints.שבת: on sabbath / on Saturday / on Shabbat

tips:
This skill deals mostly with the past tense of the hitpa'el binyan. Here is the standard conjugation pattern:

|Example|Pattern|Pronoun|
|:------:|:-----:|:--------:|
|התנצלתי (hitnatsálti)|hitXaXaXti|אני|
|התנצלתָ (hitnatsálta)|hitXaXaXta|אתה|
|התנצלתְ (hitnatsált)| hitXaXaXt| את|
|התנצל (hitnatsél)| hitXaXeX| הוא|
|התנצלה (hitnatslá)| hitXaXXa| היא|
|התנצלנו (hitnatsálnu)|hitXaXaXnu| אנחנו
|התנצלתם (hitnatsáltem)|hitXaXaXtem| אתם
|התנצלתן (hitnatsálten) | hitXaXaXten| אתן
|התנצלו (hitnatslú) | hitXaXXu| הם/הן|
